senses.gloss:
Tṛkṣi is, in the Rigveda, the name of a prince who was a trāsadasyava, ‘descendant of trasadasyu.’ He also appears with the druhyu and the pūru peoples in another hymn. It has been conjectured, but it is not probable, that the steed tārkṣya (as ‘belonging to Tṛkṣi’) was his.
Foot notes viii. 22, 7.
vi. 46, 8. It is not certain that the two persons are identical (cf. Hillebrandt, Vedische Mythologic, 1, 113, notes 3, 4), but it is probable.
Macdonell, Vedic Mythology, p. 149.
